pages.scan: I opened works/auto-6294ee8a2094/workflow/review/page-06.png with Read and looked at it. Top wide panel: close-up of a laptop screen with a hand on the trackpad. Header label: 'SPECIALITY-SPECIFIC TREATMENT PLANNER'. Three cards show teeth, an eye and a growth chart, labelled 'Dentist: odontogram', 'Eye doctor: eye markers' and 'Paediatrician: growth scales · vaccines'. Bottom large panel: the doctor gestures to Ravi, who is seated. Balloon: 'We'll go through your concerns and decide the right next steps together.' The tail points to the doctor. A teal label at left reads 'PLAN OF CARE: intelligent prescribing · summary · drug interactions · labs · referrals'. Ravi's silent reaction is a calm smile.
pages.observation: Order is clear: screen header, the three specialty cards left to right, then the doctor's line and the plan label. Text is legible. The Paediatrician label extends below the screen onto the laptop bezel and keyboard edge, and it covers the bottom of the third card. The PLAN OF CARE label covers the laptop and part of the doctor's coat and chair, but not her face or hands. The doctor's tail tip ends against her hair at the side of her head. Logic gap: a general consultation about tiredness cuts to a dentist, eye and paediatric planner with no stated link, so a first reader may wonder why it appears here. The doctor's line works as a reply to Ravi's 'tired lately' on page 5. Ravi gives no spoken answer, and his silent smile is enough.
